description: Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Culverts is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. A Culvert is a pipe (less than 3m in diameter) or half-round flume used to transport or drain water under or away from the road and/or right of way. Culverts that are greater than or equal to 3m in diameter are stored in the MoT Bridge Structure Road Dataset. It is a Point feature. Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. Its tags are CULV, MOT, MOT asset, MOT inventory, culvert. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, KML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
